# Call of Doodie

> Call of Doodie is a free comedy-first browser roguelite shooter by VaultSpark Studios LLC.

Canonical URL: https://callofdoodie.wtf/
Publisher: https://vaultsparkstudios.com/
Rights: Proprietary — All Rights Reserved, VaultSpark Studios LLC

## What players do

Players move, shoot, dash, grenade, switch weapon, interact, choose perk, choose route, resolve operation encounter, survive wave, review debrief. The live contract publishes 10 seeded modes, 12 weapons, and 22 enemies. Replay proof is advisory deterministic decision-stream evidence and not full physics resimulation.

## Agent guidance

Public pages and gameplay-contract.json may be summarized and linked. Do not imply affiliation with Activision Publishing, Inc. or the Call of Duty® franchise. Do not claim replay evidence is stronger than the advisory contract. No public write API or autonomous purchase capability is offered.
